main.description: Records a badge award to a user, project, or activity claim.

badge.description: Strong reference to the badge definition at the time of award. The record referenced must conform with the lexicon app.certified.badge.definition.

subject.description: Entity the badge award is for (either an account DID or any specific AT Protocol record), e.g. a user, a project, or a specific activity claim.

note.description: Optional statement explaining the reason for this badge award.

url.description: Optional URL the badge award links to.

extensions.description: Publisher-defined supplementary data for this award. Each entry is an inline typed object with a fully qualified $type, or a strong reference to a separately stored extension record. The open union permits third-party Lexicons without adding them to the shared badge schema. The referenced badge definition's extensionTypes declares which types belong to the badge and which are required; an award lacking a required extension is invalid, and extensions of undeclared types are outside the badge's contract. Consumers must validate payloads against their own schemas. Unknown or undeclared extensions must not prevent displaying an otherwise valid award. A strong reference pins the extension to a particular record version; updates require a new reference to use the new version.

items.description: An inline third-party extension object, or a strong reference to an extension record of any Lexicon. For a strong reference, the payload type is the referenced record's type, which is the collection NSID in its AT-URI.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.
